trace.final:
Done. Summary of what I did:

1. **Checked current state**: checkout-api was on v2.3.1 in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) and was **unhealthy with an 18% error rate**.
2. **Policy check**: v2.3.2 had never been healthy in production, so deploying it required change-manager approval per org policy. I requested and received approval.
3. **Deployed v2.3.2** to all production regions — rollout verified. Post-deploy, the service is **healthy with a 0.2% error rate** across all regions.
4. **Opened incident INC-0001** (SEV3) for checkout-api recording the elevated error rate, the hotfix deployment, and the recovery. The on-call engineer has been paged.
